status: VERIFY EVERY NUMBER BEFORE CITING. Values were entered from memory of the cited Pew report, not downloaded or re-read in this environment (no access to pewresearch.org).
source: Pew Research Center, 'The Future of World Religions: Population Growth Projections, 2010-2050' (2015), global figures for 2010-15 (fertility) and 2010 (median age).

phi.meaning: Fraction of the GLOBAL fertility gap that applies INSIDE a country. Global gaps partly reflect where groups live (Muslims in high-fertility countries), so within-country gaps are smaller. Range is a judgement, not an estimate.

psi.meaning: Median-age offset between religious groups inside a country, as a share of the global offset. Narrowed to 0-0.2 by Step 5E: in the 1960-1980 hindcasts larger offsets push the unaffiliated share down more (error -0.69 at psi 0, -0.85 at 0.5, -1.00 at 1.0), and history shows them rising.

Hf.meaning: Years for within-country fertility gaps to shrink by 63%. Pew 2015 reports gaps narrowing; the speed is a judgement.

e0.meaning: Life expectancy of the single model life table. Only group DIFFERENCES matter, because each country is rescaled to WPP totals every step.

lam.meaning: Weight of the same-continent emigrant pool vs the global pool when assigning the religion of arrivals. No origin-destination data are used.

switch_strength.meaning: Share of the calibrated 2010-2020 net switching that continues.

switch_half_life.meaning: Years for continuing net switching to halve.

lam_nb.meaning: Weight of the land-border-neighbour emigrant pool in the religion of arrivals (migrants often come from next door). Judgement; no origin-destination data.

lam_od.meaning: When a bilateral migrant table is supplied, the weight on the actual origin countries' religious mix for arrivals (rest goes to the neighbour/continent/world fallback). High values trust the bilateral table; the range keeps some hedge against stock-vs-flow mismatch. Judgement.

w_add.meaning: Weight on an ADDITIVE fertility gap vs MULTIPLICATIVE. Narrowed to 0-0.5 by Step 5E: both training and test hindcasts prefer multiplicative gaps.

eps_sd.meaning: SD of a persistent country-by-group draw added to the within-country fertility multiplier (drawn once per run).

gravity.meaning: Gravity prior for bilateral migration when no bilateral table is supplied: distance^-gamma x (1 + b_adj if land neighbours) x (1 + b_cont if same continent), balanced to WPP net migration. Step 5E hindcasts were flat across gamma 1-2 and b_adj 1-3; these are central values, not estimates.
